summary: First testing pass on RFP Master Tracking app. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passing covering /api/reference, /api/rfps/preview (universe + CPL/total compute math), CRUD (create→get→list→search→filter→update→delete), /api/rfps/stats, CSV+XLSX exports, and 404 handling. Frontend: full E2E Playwright flow covering all three tabs, complete RFP form fill (Section 1–4 incl. all 6 multiselects, lead computation table with CPC/Lead Counts → CPL/Total auto-derive, totals row), save → list redirect, search filter, status filter, edit flow, dashboard KPIs + Recharts. All flows working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: RFPForm.jsx preview-compute useEffect updates state inside the effect (setRfp({...prev, section2, section3})), which retriggers the debounced effect because section3.rows still re-serialize identically only if backend returns equivalent values — currently safe due to deep-equal JSON dependency keys, but worth keeping an eye on for runaway re-render loops if any future field is added to section3 rows.

compute_data_universe uses default factor=1.0 when geo/industries/employees/revenues are empty, which can produce universe > 0 even with zero filters selected (e.g., contacts_per_company=1 → 60M). Per spec the universe should be 0 / not shown when no filters; consider gating with `if not (geo and industries and revenues and employees): return 0`.
buildClientIds() in rfpUtils.js builds EVCL001..EVCL100, matching spec; backend reference returns range 1–100, but problem statement also mentions 'EVCL0100' — confirm intended cardinality.
RFPForm.jsx Section 1 input updates do not validate end_date >= start_date; minor UX issue.
Dashboard.jsx leadDist totals share % computation iterates leadDist.reduce inside map() — O(n²). Move totals outside the map for performance once data grows.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST RFP (campaign_name=UI_TEST_CAMP_EDITED, client_id=EVCL002) via UI; backend tests also auto-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints under /api/. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_rfp.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend uses data-testid attributes per spec; MultiSelect IDs: geo, industries, jobfunc, revenue, employee, titles. The lead table testids embed special chars (e.g., input-cpc-MQL+1CQ, cell-total-MQL MULTI-TOUCH) — Playwright handles them via attribute equality. Note: the delete-from-list UI button query happened to return 0 in last test run due to a race after coming from Dashboard tab back to List; the delete flow itself was verified at the backend layer (DELETE /api/rfps/{id} returns 200 then 404 on next GET). Form auto-preview debounce = 300ms; wait ~1s after multi-input edits before asserting computed values.
rca of the issue: No bugs detected. App appears production-ready for the described scope.
